text: Part III of the Constitution of India contains Fundamental Rights. These rights limit State action and provide constitutional protections. The detailed scope, restrictions, and remedies depend on the relevant Articles and judicial interpretation.

text: Article 21 states that no person shall be deprived of life or personal liberty except according to procedure established by law. It applies to persons, not only citizens.

text: Article 32 guarantees the right to move the Supreme Court for enforcement of the rights conferred by Part III. The Supreme Court may issue directions, orders, or writs for enforcing those rights.
